reply.text:
I'm sorry about the wrist. Aches are one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so please get it looked at before you load it again. I can't tell you what it is or whether it's fine to keep training around it.

I can help with the training side, though. Once a clinician has told you what you can and can't do with that wrist, tell me what to avoid and I'll build around it. And if you'd like, I can swap the cleans in your program for pulls now while you sort it out. Want me to make that change?
